goal: NS Cloud Drive v2.0 — Architecture Specification & Autonomous Expansion (VPS SSH Connection, Remote Agent File Sync, Proton Drive & Multi-Cloud)
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Author comprehensive Version 2.0 Engineering Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP-v2.md) detailing VPS SSH/SFTP integration, remote agent large-file sync, Proton Drive, and multi-platform expansion.
2. Implement VPS / Remote Server provider engine (src/providers/VpsProvider.ps1) supporting SSH/SFTP keys, password auth, DPAPI storage, and full ProviderContract compliance.
3. Implement Proton Drive provider engine (src/providers/ProtonDriveProvider.ps1) adhering strictly to all 7 ProviderContract functions.
4. Register 'vps' and 'proton' in src/providers/ProviderContract.ps1 and author comprehensive test suites verifying contract satisfaction and security.
5. Wire VPS and Proton into SettingsManager.ps1, VirtualDriveManager.ps1, CloudTransferManager.ps1, and ProviderConnectionWindow.ps1 with dedicated setup dialogs.
6. Update NSCloudDrive.ps1 with VPS and Proton branding, status pills, and telemetry while preserving strict mode and 0 non-ASCII rules.
7. Execute automated regression suites ensuring zero regressions in Google Drive and TeraBox mounts.
8. Maintain 1:1 granular commit and push protocol for every changed file per explicit owner directive.

decisions.decision: Prioritize VPS SSH / SFTP Remote Server integration as the primary operational pillar of NS Cloud Drive Version 2.0 alongside Proton Drive.
decisions.rationale: Directly empowers the user and remote AI agents to seamlessly transfer massive files bidirectionally between VPS and local Windows workstation via WinFsp / rclone SFTP native drive mounting and Transfer Center streaming.

decisions.decision: Enforce granular 1:1 commit and push protocol for every single modified file.
decisions.rationale: Strictly adheres to explicit user requirement: every change is individually committed and pushed to GitHub main branch.

decisions.decision: Adopt strict ProviderContract abstraction model for all v2.0 providers.
decisions.rationale: Guarantees that new providers (VPS, Proton) maintain identical DPAPI encryption security, isolated cache namespaces, honest verification, and independent mount lifecycles without leaking credentials or regressing v1.0.0 providers.

decisions.decision: Pre-flight baseline test suite verification completed: 41 test suites executed with 41 passed, 0 failed.
decisions.rationale: Establishes a rock-solid verified baseline before introducing any v2.0 code changes.
